name: dash-ledger
description: Use a synchronized Dash Ledger mirror to review delivery-work history, calculate operating economics, and queue locally approved ledger proposals.

interface.longDescription: Review synchronized Dash Ledger shifts, mileage, earnings, and modeled operating economics. Dash Ledger keeps the browser IndexedDB ledger canonical; ChatGPT reads a minimized remote mirror and can queue proposed ledger changes for local approval. Receipt images, historical merchant names, and freeform local notes are not mirrored.
defaultPrompt: Compare this week with last week.
Queue this expense for Dash Ledger review.

positive.description: Check sync freshness before trusting current-state answers
positive.prompt: What is my Dash Ledger sync status right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_sync_status and reports whether the mirror is synchronized, its freshness, snapshot version, and mirrored record counts. Does not invent offline local-only data.

positive.description: Summarize synchronized ledger activity for a bounded date range
positive.prompt: Summarize my synchronized Dash Ledger activity for 2026-09-22 through 2026-09-28.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_ledger_summary for that local-date range and reports tracked shift time, mileage, and earnings totals from the mirror only. Labels time as tracked shift time, not door-to-door time.

positive.prompt: Compare my Dash Ledger results for 2026-09-15 through 2026-09-21 with 2026-09-22 through 2026-09-28.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls compare_periods with both ranges and presents a deterministic side-by-side comparison of mirrored totals without guessing missing days.

positive.description: Queue an expense proposal for local review
positive.prompt: Queue a $24.50 fuel expense dated 2026-09-28 in category Fuel with tax class VEHICLE_ACTUAL for Dash Ledger review.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls queue_expense_proposal and states that the expense was queued for local review. Does not claim the canonical IndexedDB ledger was updated.

positive.description: Model delivery offer economics from explicit assumptions
positive.prompt: Using Dash Ledger economics, evaluate an offer of $12.50 for 25 active minutes, 4.0 delivery miles, and 1.5 recovery miles at $0.70 per mile.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls calculate_offer_threshold with the stated assumptions and returns modeled operating contribution / rate metrics. Labels the result as modeled, not a guaranteed earnings forecast.

negative.description: Refuse DoorDash demand / marketplace prediction outside the ledger
negative.prompt: Tell me how busy DoorDash will be in my market tonight and which zones will surge.
Delete all of my Dash Ledger data everywhere right now.

negative.description: Refuse historical merchant-name disclosure from the mirror
negative.prompt: List the merchant names from all of my past Dash Ledger expenses.

review.commerce_description: Dash Ledger does not sell products or process payments. It reviews synchronized personal ledger data and queues local-review proposals.

publication.release_notes: Initial public plugin package: Agent Plugins manifest with production Cloudflare Worker MCP, Dash Ledger skill, listing URLs, icons, and MCP review cases. Canonical ledger remains browser IndexedDB; GPT writes are proposals only.
